shared_tail.surface: إسحاق بن عبد الله بن أبي طلحة

notes: The taḥwīل ح joins two branches; «قالا جميعا حدثنا» then writes the shared tail once, so it belongs to both branches.
The gloss «وهو ابن شداد» is left out (rule 1). «بمثله في المعنى» is a wording remark and is left out (rule 4).
«في، هذا الإسناد» is the Sunni back-reference, kept as the final link of the shared tail.
